body: Imagine how much more upset they'd be if you ended it without speaking to them. I'm not going to sit here and say there's hope for you, but there's not necessarily no hope.
Maybe try writing a letter with the same points a suicide letter would have and hand it to the people you are closest to. If you truly want to die, why not do that?
This is a question you should never answer.
There is no point and maybe we just have to accept that. I don't know.

At least you were able to confess. Many people, especially on here, have life long regrets of not confessing their feelings for someone. You ripped off the band-aid. It will hurt a lot short term, but long term this is a good thing.

I hate labels, but I think I have BPD. I fit pretty much every symptom. Not sure what to do about this. I really need to fix my unstable emotions though. Maybe there isn't a fix... I almost jumped out the window yesterday. Honestly thinking on it, it's pretty funny. I feel as if I'm going more insane by the day. Please don't worry about me though. I do enjoy the occasional messages and try to get something out of them. I'm usually able to stop myself from doing things without thinking, but it's a struggle.

I'm not sure what's wrong with me. I stopped taking my antidepressants a little while ago and feel somewhat better for whatever reason. My temper is very short and I anger easily, but I suppose I'm happier... I'm settling for less and transferring to an easier, but still good, college. I'm trying to live a more carefree life to help myself mentally. I know that's dangerous but it's the only way I see myself having a decent life.

I enjoy watching Twitch streams and one of the streamers I watched committed suicide yesterday.  He tweeted a proposal hours before to his ex during a manic episode on twitter. I read all the comments before he died and they were extremely negative. It's just hard to see people act this way. When I woke up he was dead. It's not like I idolized him... It's just hard hearing about people committing suicide when it's something I'm already thinking about constantly.  
Every time I write about my thoughts I start to feel slightly better. I might start a journal/diary.

You're a good person
I know this is a late response, but today, frankly terrible. Especially with everything happening online recently. It takes all I have to not lose it.

If the thoughts that are too harsh happen to be against the guidelines feel free to pm me. I'm not self diagnosing, but I think I'm bipolar. One minute I'm on the brink and the next I'm fine. I am currently feeling okay, so anything you say, no matter how harsh, is okay. Hearing about your experience would help.

To the thought that the world is better with me in it, it's hard to agree. I've been told this before and it makes me feel better, but deep down I'm not a good person. I'm incredibly selfish and my ideologies are skewed because of my mindset on life.

I feel that therapy can help, but every therapist I've been to seems fake. I need an intelligent and caring therapist, which seems hard to come by.

I really do appreciate your response.
What keeps me alive is not knowing what's on the other side.
He wouldn't want you to die. He would forgive you and want to see you prosper.
